title: aluminum oil sprayer
text:
aluminum oil sprayer. I purchased these as part of a pantry gift for a friend who needed help in feeding a family of 5! She reports it is so handy and real money saver. I have two myself... one for vegetable oil and one for olive oil. I few quick pumps and spray. No added chemicals or alcohol which can harm your non-stick cookware. Highly recommend! FYI: As I have shopped these in a few places, I found that the Amazon price of around 10 bucks is on the mark.
UPDATE: 2/16/2017... I recently purchased another one of these... and it didn't work. I emptied it and refilled it...it finally worked. Honestly I don't like having to pump it. There is a different sprayer I like better, no pumping necessary - a fast pull on the trigger releases a stream, a slower pull produces a nice fanned spray. Glass bottom. I purchased it on Amazon as well.

product_metadata.title: Misto Tritan Oil Sprayer, One Size, White
features: HEALTHY EATING: enjoy better control of adding oil and spray to salads, veggies, pasta, pizza, and more
FINE MIST: ensures a light amount of oil on food or cooking surfaces
EASY TO USE: just pump to pressurize the bottle, then spray
UNIQUE FILTER: keeps the sprayer clear and allows you to create your own flavors with herbs and spices
ECO-FRIENDLY: nonaerosol BPA-free container can be refilled over and over again
description: You can fill your MISTO with your favorite oils vinegars lemon and lime juice as well as sherry or marsala wine Perfect for low fat/high flavor cooking grilling sauteing roasting and basting Refill reuse again and again
